name: module-tests
command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 90s .venv/bin/pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_handoffs.py tests/test_handoff_pipeline.py tests/test_handoff_cli.py

name: build
command: BASELINE cached backend PYTHONPATH; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/hiro-agent-uv-cache uv build --offline --no-build-isolation --out-dir /tmp/hiro-agent-d-dist
